text_en: To the leader: to Jeduthun. A Psalm of David.
text_cn: 达味诗歌，交与乐官耶杜通。

text_en: I said, “I will guard my ways that I may not sin with my tongue; I will keep a muzzle on my mouth as long as the wicked are in my presence. ”
text_cn: 我已决定：“我要谨遵我的道路，免得我以口舌犯罪， 当恶人在我面前时，我以口罩笼住我嘴。”

text_en: I was silent and still; I held my peace to no avail; my distress grew worse,
text_cn: 我默不作声，以免口出恶语， 但我的痛楚，更因此而加剧。

text_en: my heart became hot within me. While I mused, the fire burned; then I spoke with my tongue:
text_cn: 我的心在我腔内滚滚沸腾， 我愈沉思愈觉得烈火如焚； 我的舌头便不耐烦地说：

text_en: “ Lord , let me know my end, and what is the measure of my days; let me know how fleeting my life is.
text_cn: “上主，我恳求你明白启示我： 我的终期和寿数究有几何， 好使我知道我是何等脆弱。”

text_en: You have made my days a few handbreadths, and my lifetime is as nothing in your sight. Surely everyone stands as a mere breath. Selah
text_cn: 看，你使我的岁月屈指可数， 我的生命在你前算是虚无。 世人的生存，只是一口呵嘘。 （休止）

text_en: Surely everyone goes about like a shadow. Surely for nothing they are in turmoil; they heap up, and do not know who will gather.
text_cn: 人生实如泡影，只是白白操劳， 他们所有积蓄，不知谁来得到。

text_en: “And now, O Lord, what do I wait for? My hope is in you.
text_cn: 我主，现今我还有什么希望？ 我的希望寄托在你的身上！

text_en: Deliver me from all my transgressions. Do not make me the scorn of the fool.
text_cn: 求你救我脱离我的种种罪愆， 不要使我受愚人的耻笑侮慢。

text_en: I am silent; I do not open my mouth, for it is you who have done it.
text_cn: 我静默不言，有口不开， 因为这事是由你安排。

text_en: Remove your stroke from me; I am worn down by the blows of your hand.
text_cn: 求你由我身上除去这场灾患， 因你手的打击，我已消瘦不堪。

text_en: “You chastise mortals in punishment for sin, consuming like a moth what is dear to them; surely everyone is a mere breath. Selah
text_cn: 你为了罚罪而把世人惩治，你像蛀虫将他的珍宝侵蚀； 至于人，不过只是一口气。 （休止）

text_en: “Hear my prayer, O Lord , and give ear to my cry; do not hold your peace at my tears. For I am your passing guest, an alien, like all my forebears.
text_cn: 上主，求你俯听我的祈祷， 求你侧耳静听我的哀告， 莫要装聋不听我的哭号。 因为我在你前只是旅客， 如我列祖一样只是路过。

text_en: Turn your gaze away from me, that I may smile again, before I depart and am no more. ”
text_cn: 求你转移你的目光，不要怒视我， 使我一去不返之前，能得享安乐。
